current.text: He will likely miss the start of the season. He would have been in the Atlanta rotation if healthy.
He has the only non-guaranteed contract on the Atlanta roster.
Atlanta is two players over the roster limit. He is one of the candidates to be cut or traded before opening day.
He is likely to play the three next to Caleb Wilson, so he should contest fewer shots at the rim and block fewer shots.
Atlanta is deep. Lloyd expects a 10-man rotation that does not include Gueye while he is hurt.

durable.text: He is a solid defender, a good rebounder and a good steals generator for his minutes.
His shooting is up and down.
He converted 24.5% of his rim contests into blocks.
He scores very little. Points are his weakest category and far below the top 250 pool.

note: Gueye is not a draft target. Yahoo ranks him 290, ESPN 267, both sites value him at 0 USD, and he went undrafted in our league last season. Our draft takes only 144 players. He has a broken foot and a non-guaranteed contract, and he played about 15 minutes a game for 4.4 points last season, so there is no reason to roster him now. Check whether Atlanta keeps him past opening day. Then watch his minutes once he is healthy, since the experts rate his defense, rebounding and steals.
